# Icon button (`icon-button`)

Icon-only button with tones, sizes and a filled variant.

Group: Actions. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/actions';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIconButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let muted = false;

const mute = createIconButton({
  icon: 'volume-high',
  label: 'Mute',
  pressed: muted,
  onClick: () => {
    muted = !muted;
    mute.setPressed(muted);
    mute.setIcon(muted ? 'volume-off' : 'volume-high');
  },
});

document.body.append(mute.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function IconButtonExample() {
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false);
  return (
    <IconButton
      icon={muted ? 'volume-off' : 'volume-high'}
      label="Mute"
      pressed={muted}
      onClick={() => setMuted(!muted)}
    />
  );
}
```
